error.FILE_NAME: file name must be <slug>.plan with a lowercase kebab-case slug
error.NOT_PLAN_LINE: not a plan line (every line is "#tag ..."), got "{line}"

error.ID_MISMATCH: id {id} does not match the file name {name}
error.TEXT_CONTROL: {what} contains a control character (one line, no tabs)
error.TEXT_TOO_LONG: {what} is {length} characters, the cap is {cap}; split it or shorten it
error.TOO_MANY_LINES: more than {max} {what} lines; keep it short
error.BAD_PERCENT: {token} has a % that is not %20, %23 or %25
error.TOUCH_SHAPE: must be "#touch <area|feature|file|new> <target>" and nothing after the target (encode a space as %20)
error.TOUCH_ORPHAN: #touch comes after a #stage, an #item or a #question
error.QUESTION_LINE_ORPHAN: comes right after the #question it belongs to
error.FLOW_STEP_AFTER_BELOW: comes after #below; the row under comes last
error.FLOW_TOO_MANY_STORIES: more than {max} stories under one question
error.FLOW_FILE_WORDS: takes one path and nothing after it (encode a space as %20)
error.FLOW_FILE_MAX: has more than {max} files on one step
error.FLOW_FILE_NO_STEP: comes before any #step or #below it could belong to
error.ANSWER_ORPHAN: #answer comes right after the #question it answers
error.ANSWER_WHO: needs who answered, then the answer ("#answer jun Yes, keep it.")
error.APPROVED_LEVEL_DIGEST: the plan-level approval takes no digest
error.APPROVED_DIGEST: a section approval ends with the 12-hex digest of the section as approved
error.STAGE_ID: stage id "{id}" must be s1, s2, ... in order
error.ITEM_ID: item id "{id}" must be s<stage>.<n>, such as {stage}.1
error.ITEM_STAGE: item {id} sits under stage {stage}; its id must start with {stage}.
error.QUESTION_ORPHAN: question without a stage: put #question after the #stage it blocks
error.QUESTION_ID: question id "{id}" must be s<stage>.q<n>, such as {stage}.q1
error.QUESTION_STAGE: question {id} sits under stage {stage}; its id must start with {stage}.
error.SEQUENCE: {what} out of order: {id} stands at position {position}, expected {expected} (numbers run 1, 2, 3 ... in file order)
error.STAGE_ORDER: stage order: {id} stands at position {position}, expected {expected} (stages run s1, s2, s3 ... in file order)
error.STAGE_NO_ITEM: stage {id} has no #item; a stage is what gets implemented, give it items
error.ITEM_NO_ACCEPT: item {id} has no #accept: the check that proves it is done
error.ITEM_NO_TOUCH: item {id} has no #touch: name the features or files it changes (plan.mjs impact lists them)
error.VERIFIED_NO_ITEM: #verified {item}: the plan has no such item
error.APPROVAL_NO_SECTION: #approved {section}: the plan has no such section (sections: {sections})
error.OPEN_SECTION_STALE: the plan is approved ("#approved {level}") but section {section} is changed since it was approved; approve it again with plan.mjs approve
error.OPEN_SECTION_PENDING: the plan is approved ("#approved {level}") but section {section} is not approved; approve it again with plan.mjs approve
error.FILE_NOT_IN_MAP: {path} exists but the map has no record of it; refresh the map first (lantern-setup)
error.FILE_NEVER_MAPPED: {path} is not in the map and never was; copy paths from plan.mjs impact, do not guess them
error.NEW_NO_PURPOSE: {path} is touched as a new file but has no purpose: add "#impact new {path} <what it is for>"
error.NO_FEATURES: the map declares no features (.lantern/features), so a feature cannot be named
error.NO_AREAS: the map has no .lantern/areas, so an area cannot be named; name features instead

error.EDIT_ADD_EMPTY: add {kind}: the last argument is empty

error.EDIT_NO_SECTION: no section {section}; sections: {sections}, or "{level}" once all are approved

error.NEEDS_TITLE_GOAL:

line.USAGE:
usage: plan.mjs <command> [options]   (run from the project root, or pass --root <dir>)
  gate                                              the map is settled and the planning skills are installed
  skills                                            which planning skills resolve, and what to read before each step
  new <slug> --title <text> --goal <text>...        start .lantern/plans/<slug>.plan
  impact [--file <path|dir/>]... [--feature <id>]... [--area <id>]... [--depth 1-{maxDepth}]
  add <slug> <kind> <args...> [--touch <kind>:<target>]... [--accept <text>] [--flow-file <json>] [--replace]
      kinds: {addKinds}
  check <slug|path.plan>... | --all                 shape, map and approval checks (exit 1 on errors)
  show <slug> [<section>]                           the review queue, or one section as written
  approve <slug> <section|plan> --by <who> [--date YYYY-MM-DD]
  verified <slug> <item> --by <who> [--date YYYY-MM-DD]
  status <slug>                                     item status from the PR records, and what comes next
  handoff <slug>                                    the next items to delegate; exit 1 unless the plan is approved and clean
  list
every command takes --json
line.NEW_NEXT: next: plan.mjs impact ..., then plan.mjs add {slug} scope|impact|stage|item|question ...
line.QUEUE_ALL_DONE: every section and the plan are approved
line.QUEUE_APPROVE_PLAN: every section is approved: plan.mjs approve {slug} {level} --by <who>
line.GATE_MAP_HINT: Planning needs a settled Lantern map. Set the map up or refresh it with lantern-setup, then ask for the plan again.
line.GATE_NO_SETUP: FAIL map: lantern-setup is not installed beside lantern-plan ({validate}). Install it with `pnpm run install-skills -- <project>` in the Lantern repo.
line.SKILLS_MISSING: {count} planning skill(s) missing: {names}. Install them with `pnpm run install-skills -- <project>` in the Lantern repo (opening the project in Lantern does the same), then run this again.
line.SKILLS_ALL_OK: every planning skill resolves. Read the one named for each step before you do it:
line.NEXT_BLOCKED: next: stage {stage} is blocked, ask the user:
line.NEXT_NOTHING: next: nothing left, every item is implemented
line.BLOCK_SECTIONS_OPEN: the plan is not approved; sections still open: {open}
line.BLOCK_RUN_APPROVE: the plan is not approved; run plan.mjs approve <slug> plan
line.HANDOFF_DONE: plan {slug}: every item is implemented; nothing to delegate
line.HANDOFF_READY: plan {slug}: approved and clean, next stage {stage}
line.HANDOFF_DELEGATE: delegate these items, one delegate each, at most {max} at a time:
line.HANDOFF_ASK: stage {stage} is blocked; ask the user before delegating:
line.HANDOFF_RECORD_ANSWER: then record each answer: plan.mjs add {slug} answer <question id> <who> <answer>
line.HANDOFF_NOTHING_READY: nothing ready: every open item is waiting on a pull request
line.HANDOFF_NEXT_ASK: stage {stage} is blocked by {count} question(s) to ask first
line.HANDOFF_NEXT_WAITING: stage {stage} is waiting on pull requests
line.IMPACT_NEXT: next: write #impact lines for what this work really changes, one reason each: the files by name (plan.mjs add <slug> impact file <path> <reason>), the features and areas, and every file it will create (plan.mjs add <slug> impact new <path> <purpose>). Read lantern-plan-impact for which of the files above are relevant.
line.PREFLIGHT_NOT_READY: {slug} cannot be handed over: {reasons}. Fix it with lantern-plan-review, then run preflight again.
line.PREFLIGHT_NOT_ON_BASE: {slug} is approved but {rel} {what} on {ref}, the base the delegates fork from. Commit the approved plan and push {target} first.
line.PREFLIGHT_OK: {slug} is approved and clean; {next}. Put "Plan: {slug}" in the brief and --plan {slug} --item <id> on the delegate's sync.mjs pr.

noun.TITLE: the title
noun.QUESTION: the question
noun.IMPACT_DEPENDENTS_FURTHER: further dependents (second hop: files that use a dependent)
noun.IMPACT_DEPENDENCIES_FURTHER: further dependencies (second hop: files a dependency uses)
noun.IMPACT_SYSTEMS: outside systems the seeds talk to
noun.PURPOSE_ENTRY: Entry: the map gate, the seven-step process, which skill to read before each step.
noun.PURPOSE_IMPACT: Impact analysis on the map: plan.mjs impact, dependents and dependencies, the #impact section.
noun.PURPOSE_STAGES: Stages, items with acceptance checks, and the open questions that belong to each stage.
noun.PURPOSE_REVIEW: Showing the plan one section at a time and recording each approval, then the plan-level one.
noun.PURPOSE_HANDOFF: Handing an approved plan to lantern-delegate, and ticking items through pull request records.
noun.STEP_WRITE: write and check the plan file

view.COPY_HEADER: Lantern plan {slug}: answers and requests for "{title}"
view.COPY_SCOPE: Record each answer in .lantern/plans/{slug}.plan with the lantern-plan skill (plan.mjs add {slug} answer <question id> <who> <answer>) and update the plan wherever an answer changes it. For a request to explain a question, add #explain lines under it (plan.mjs add {slug} explain <question id> <text>); for a request to draw its flow, add #story, #step, #below and #file lines (plan.mjs add {slug} flow <question id> --flow-file <json>). Then run plan.mjs check {slug}, add any new question the answers raise to the stage it blocks, and list the questions still open.
